title: Law to publish live snow plow tracking data
summary: This bill would require the Department of Sanitation to equip snow plows with GPS and post plowing data online within 5 days of operations, with historical data posted by October 31, 2027. It would also require a public map updated every 15 minutes during snow plowing showing current and past routes by date, storm, borough and district, with overlays for schools, hospitals and other critical facilities.
